first_ui_question.text:
Confirm goal

Harden SVG text generation in `bench/report.py` against XML/SVG injection, with adversarial regression tests and parser-validated output.  Current state - `bench/report.py` (489 lines) is the only SVG producer. Two writers build documents by f-string interpolation: `chart()` (line 99, multi-panel bar charts) and `hero()` (line 152, the README headline figure). - Dynamic text reaching markup comes from: `--label name=text` (line 304), `environment.txt`-derived labels (lines 276-301), `--builds` names and `LABELS.get(b, b)` fallbacks (lines 112, 137, 152-215), JSONL-derived panel/tile/step/plugin names (e.g. `step_name()`, the `plugins.jsonl` `plugin` field at line 436, `names[k]` at line 438), chart titles/subtitles composed in `main()`, formatted values from `fmt()`, ratio notes from `ratio_text()`, and the `aria-label` attribute on the root `<svg>`. - Nothing is escaped today; `xml.etree` cannot be expected to parse a document built from hostile metadata. - The layout helpers `text_width()` (line 81) and `color_of()` (line 70) intentionally operate on raw, unescaped text. - There is no Python test suite for `bench/`; CI only runs `python3 -m py_compile bench/*.py` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:102`). - `docs/images/*.svg` are committed but were generated from a different results folder and Pi version, so they are not a byte-comparable baseline (verified: regenerating from `bench/results/2026-10-12-linux-x64-0.8.5` already differs).  Decisions 1. Escape at the write boundary, one helper pair. Add module-level `esc(text)` (escapes `&` `<` `>` `"` `'` — `& < > " '`) and `attr(text)` delegating to it, applied at every interpolation site inside `chart()` and `hero()`, including the `aria-label` attribute. Rejected: escaping inputs at ingestion — a label renders in several places (legend, table header, plugin names) so it would be escaped twice, producing `&amp;`, and it misses sources added later. ## Original completion claim (verbatim)

Outcome: SVGs drawn by bench/report.py can no longer be broken or injected into by text from --label, environment.txt or the results JSONL; ordinary charts are byte-for-byte unchanged.
Changed: every dynamic string and attribute value is escaped once at the point it is written into the markup, with characters XML forbids dropped, so hostile metadata still yields a document a standard parser accepts.
Evidence: bench/report.py (esc/attr helpers applied at all insertion sites in chart() and hero()), bench/test_report.py, bench/fixtures/report plus bench/fixtures/report-golden, bench/README.md section "Text in the charts".
Tests: python3 -m unittest bench/test_report.py — 21 passed, 0 failed; golden CLI regeneration diff — identical, 12 SVGs; real results folder — 10 documents parsed by xml.etree; hostile --label run — no script element, all documents parsed; python3 -m py_compile bench/*.py — clean.
Unresolved: the new tests are not wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml (CI still only compiles bench/*.py), matching the agreed scope; Markdown table output is untouched and remains unescaped by design.
Next: if you want the regression tests enforced in CI, add `python3 -m unittest bench/test_report.py` beside the existing py_compile step.
